Well, it's a loose term that doesn't hold real significance. You don't have to refer to yourself as millennials or Gen Y. You can create a new name for yourself, and that's the point. You dictate the greatest things that come out of your generation and which things you become known for even if there will always be controversy about how credit or blame is assigned.

Of course, it is going to be used for marketing, but that's not it's only significance. There are larger questions about how we define generations and their social significance. There's nothing inherently bad about being associated with the turn of the millennium. The problem is that it already has lots of negative connotations that have been associated with it for one reason or another. New generations will always be under possibly undue pressure. Being considered entitled or babies could probably be shrugged off if it didn't have a particularly large grain of truth. There are many questionable trends in play, but there is one that has built disturbing notoriety. Popularized social justice extremism has taken new twists that no one really can explain no matter what generation they come from. I was born in the mid-80's and I wonder why certain things were allowed to happen to give us this awful situation. Maybe it can be ignored, but the world is always becoming stranger, so I'll just call it Gen Why until we figure out what the hell is going on.
